__comment: Block type registry - the hot-path file. Loaded once at boot and cached.
Each key is the PERMANENT save-file string. Runtime IDs are session-only
integers mapped from these keys at load time - never store integers in saves.
See data/terrain/NAMING_RULES.md for key format conventions.
surface grass and dirt use hex_color as the SUMMER baseline only.
At runtime the renderer looks up the active colour from:
If the palette file is absent or the key is missing, hex_color is used as fallback.
Block IDs never change between seasons - only the rendered colour swaps.
